narr: A cold front and upper-level wave moving across the area triggered scattered showers and thunderstorms during the afternoon and early evening. Thunderstorms produced excessive rainfall rates over Chenango County and contributed to areas of flooding on a few roads.
ev: Water was reported over the roadway on County Road 17 and Searles Hill Road.
